metadata.title: mountainash-transport Concept Graph
metadata.description: Internal concept dependency graph for the mountainash-transport package documentation rebuild: ecosystem boundary, package surface, paths and location policy, storage profiles, facade operations, read access modes, stream transforms, connections and HTTP engine, protocols and registry, backends, errors and maintenance.
metadata.creator: Nathaniel Ramm
metadata.id_policy: Replacement graph. IDs start at 101 so no ID from the retired 1.0 graph (IDs 1-90, mountainash_utils_files, baseline 65bc90f) is reused with a different meaning.
metadata.enrichment: Seeded 2026-10-29 from an explicit reviewed concept-to-module mapping (confidence 1.0); conceptual and ecosystem concepts have null source_module.
